v4.6.73 — Make Bot universe rework

✨ NEW
• Make Bot now has a “Ticker universe” dropdown. Pick one of the curated, pre-scored PUBLIC universes (long_term, short, short_term, speculative, options, crypto) that the APEX server regenerates every week — your bot is built to trade exactly those tickers. Or leave it on “Let the AI choose” to have the model pick symbols from your description.
• The chosen universe is baked into the bot at creation and stamped into its META, so you assign a universe ONCE instead of fiddling with it later.

🧹 REMOVED / SIMPLIFIED
• Make Bot no longer asks whether to create a “trading bot” or a “universe generator.” It always makes a trading bot; universes are produced on the server now.
• Each bot tab no longer shows a per-bot “Universe bot” dropdown — the universe is fixed at creation.

Update via the in-app banner.
